acceptance: fresh state document validates against schemas/state.json and has empty /controls, /bindings, /plugins (empty-state invariant)

title: ds-ipc control plane: Unix socket, NDJSON, hello/auth, scopes, errors, limits, client crate
acceptance: NDJSON request/response over the Unix control socket per docs/contracts/ipc.md, validated against schemas/ipc-message.json

title: ds-ipc frame plane: DSF1 stream socket, credits/acks, limits
acceptance: DSF1 binary frames over the stream socket per docs/contracts/streaming.md, validated against schemas/stream-frame.json
stream-ack/stream-nack flow with credits and per-target limits enforced

title: ds-device: virtual transport and report codec (device-agnostic driver core)
acceptance: ds-device builds against mh-device (git dep, ADR-010) with a virtual transport implementation
module report codec decodes/encodes reports; chunk reassembly verified by tests
device trait allows virtual:/tmp/vdev.sock style addressing

title: ds-daemon skeleton: state task, IPC server, device task, lifecycle, token, logs
acceptance: ds daemon start --device virtual:/tmp/vdev.sock binds the control socket, writes a 0600 token, starts from empty state, logs lifecycle
state task owns the ds-state document; IPC server (ds-ipc control) serves get/set; device task owns the ds-device transport

title: ds CLI: get/set/watch/schema/describe/daemon/status; output modes and exit codes
acceptance: ds get/set/watch/schema/describe/daemon/status work against a running daemon per docs/contracts/cli.md
--json prints one object; streaming verbs support --ndjson and exit 1 on --json; exit codes 0-8 stable; --help at every level
ds migrate exits 1 (no migrate verb exists)
verification: scripted smoke against ds-vdev + ds daemon (PLAN.md walking skeleton steps 3-6)

title: ds-vdev: virtual hub (module reports, chunk reassembly, inject, throttle, frame sha) + ds-vdevctl
acceptance: ds-vdev --socket /tmp/vdev.sock serves a report-level virtual MasterHub; ds daemon can connect via virtual:/tmp/vdev.sock
ds-vdevctl --socket /tmp/vdev.sock frames key:0 prints the reassembled frame sha256 after an image set
inject and throttle controls work for conformance/bench use
verification: smoke: ds-vdev up, ds daemon start --device virtual:/tmp/vdev.sock, ds set image, ds-vdevctl frames key:0 sha matches

acceptance: python tests/conformance/run.py starts a daemon on ds-vdev (or a mock) and runs the suite, exit 0

acceptance: tests/e2e runs the PLAN.md walking skeleton end to end: ds set /controls/keys/0/image --file examples/key.png -> ds-vdevctl frames key:0 prints the golden sha256

acceptance: ds-device gains a hid: transport that enumerates and opens the MasterHub via hidraw/libusb on Linux

verification: DS_HARDWARE=1 python tests/hw/smoke.py enumerate step green on the real deck

title: Software-mode handshake, module init, safe builders on real hardware
acceptance: daemon brings the real deck through the software-mode handshake before any read (invariant: software-mode handshake before reads)
module init sequence runs; all writes go through ds-protocol safe builders
hardware smoke handshake step green

title: Hot-plug rescan, reconnect, re-push, unresponsive-device handling
acceptance: unplug/replug of the deck is detected and the daemon reconnects, re-handshakes, and re-pushes state within 5 s

verification: DS_HARDWARE=1 python tests/hw/smoke.py replug step green (<= 5 s)

acceptance: on SIGTERM/exit the daemon hands the deck back (safe state: no half-pushed frames, backlight per policy, no backlight-0) and exits 0

hardware smoke SIGTERM handback step green
verification: DS_HARDWARE=1 python tests/hw/smoke.py SIGTERM handback step green
cargo test -p ds-daemon (guard unit tests with mock device)
